verdict.rationale: Scaffolding a new agent project from an official CLI or template is a fair question for an agent framework, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents SDK primitives such as Runner, tools, handoffs and sandbox agents, but nothing shows an official CLI, create command or project template that scaffolds a project in one command. The llms.txt and markdown docs probes help coding agents read the docs, but that is an adjacent feature, not scaffolding.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have a coding agent scaffold a new agent project from an official CLI or template in one command
